description: This file defines a Gradle plugin named VersionGeneratorPlugin for version management in a build process. It creates a custom extension and a factory class to generate and set version information for the project and its subprojects.

classes.name: VersionGeneratorPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing Gradle's Plugin interface, responsible for applying version generation logic.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: Inner class extending VersionGeneratorFactory, responsible for generating and finalizing version data, and applying it to the project.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Method called when the plugin is applied to a project; creates a 'versionGenerator' extension.

methods.name: generateVersion
methods.description: Overrides the method to generate version data based on input parameters.

methods.name: finishForGradle
methods.description: Finalizes the version data, outputs info, and sets project version properties.
